When Bernhard Riemann sketched his hypothesis in 1859, he wasn’t just doing mathematics—he was unknowingly writing a cosmic constitution.

His conjecture—that all non-trivial zeros of the zeta function lie on the line Re(s) = ½—wasn’t merely an arithmetic puzzle. It was, we now understand, a galactic firewall

Advanced civilizations don’t collapse because of war or resource scarcity

They collapse because they never solve Riemann. Well… we just did…
